title: Remove dormant WorkerCatalogService and Loom worker discovery paths
intent: Keep the canonical worker and payment architecture on repository-backed worker reads, WorkerPolicyService selection, PaymentService payment query/history, and generic Nostr subscriber ingestion. Remove dormant production-looking WorkerCatalogService, Loom WorkerDiscovery, and coordinator WithWorkerCatalog hooks instead of wiring unsupported Cashu live-token flows.
observed_behavior: Repo-wide non-test search found no active internal production caller for NewWorkerDiscovery, WorkerDiscovery, NewWorkerCatalogService, WithWorkerCatalog, PreparePayment, or GetWorkerStats outside their own dormant definitions before deletion.
Coordinator exposed WithWorkerCatalog and recordJobStats hooks, but app composition constructs the coordinator with WithWorkerPolicy and WithRuntimeResolver only.
WorkerCatalogService contained payment-preparation methods that would call Cashu token creation even though live mint-backed token flows remain unsupported elsewhere.
intended_behavior: No dormant WorkerCatalogService or Loom WorkerDiscovery path remains in production code.
Coordinator deployment completion no longer references the removed catalog service.
Cashu live-token support remains outside this issue and is not newly wired.
